title: [BUG] Blend orchestrator: mirror accepted orders into paper_trader order manager
edge_cases: No paper trader or order manager is available while a synthetic identity arrives.
Several accepted orders are open and one paper fill arrives with a synthetic identity.
A canonical identity arrives directly after a prior unresolved mapping.
A display-name identity alias is used for downstream risk cancellation.
An order closes and its canonical identity is reused for a later accepted signal.
description: Resolve synthetic execution identities against accepted blend signals, retain a reverse mapping for close callbacks, and mirror a Position when a paper order manager is available.

confidence.justification: Source inspection shows the paper execution creates the order-manager Position, while downstream callbacks can carry display or default identities. The mapping boundary now resolves the canonical ID, filters cancelled risk slots, and mirrors only when a paper position is absent.
